memory_update.text: PLPC should be carried forward as the highest-purity underfollowed public candidate for transmission-line hardware/fittings, subject to verification of revenue mix, backlog quality, customer qualification, and order timing versus EPC activity.
HUBB should remain a reference anchor rather than the primary discovery candidate because its Utility Solutions segment is relevant but diversified across many grid and utility categories.

ACA and VMI should be tracked as adjacent utility-structure and substation-hardware suppliers; their relevance is strongest if transmission structure capacity, lead times, and utility qualification become bottlenecks.

Need to verify whether smaller public distributors, testing/inspection firms, or utility hardware distributors have material transmission-line hardware exposure; initial pass found stronger evidence in PLPC, HUBB, ACA, and VMI.
Private competitors and suppliers such as MacLean Power Systems may be important for competitive mapping even though they are not investable as standalone public equities.

node: Transmission-line hardware, fittings, conductor accessories, and installation-specific components
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around the physical transmission bill-of-materials layer. The cleanest underfollowed candidate is Preformed Line Products, whose Energy Products include transmission/distribution support, protection, termination, splicing, and substation connectors. Hubbell is the obvious diversified reference anchor. Arcosa and Valmont are not conductor-fitting pure plays, but they sit one step away in engineered utility structures, poles, substations, and grid-hardening hardware where utility qualification, capacity, backlog, and fabrication lead times may create similar chokepoint dynamics. No recommendation is made; this is a Layer 1B research universe expansion only.
